plagiarism_flags.quote: PPO, GRPO, and DPO are often compared as if the algorithm label were the full experimental treatment.
The familiar $p_x > 1/G$ rule is only an expected-one-success heuristic; it is not a threshold theorem.
Online reward curves measure the reward environment that produced the update.
Without those controls, ``PPO versus GRPO'' is not an interpretable scientific claim.
We do not claim tool-execution competence; tool-call results measure schema compliance only.
